Level1.Title: The First Stand
Level1.Message: The dead walk again. A horde of undead has overrun the outer village, and you must make a stand as the last line of defense. Steel your nerves — this is only the beginning.

Level2.Title: Into the Ruins
Level2.Message: You pushed them back, but the threat still grows. Goblin scouts have been spotted moving through the ruins, emboldened by the chaos. Root them out before they rally.

Level3.Title: The Final Descent
Level3.Message: The source of the corruption lies ahead. One final push. Whatever awaits you in the depths, you must face it. There is no retreat.

END.Title: Victory
END.Message: The corruption has been purged. Against all odds, you held the line. The land breathes easier now — but the scars of battle remain. Rest, hero. You've earned it.
